note: TotalSegmentator release check (study lead 10-08 item 4). Each run re-runs the round-2 call (fast=True, ml=True, organ roi_subset) on pancreas_125 and FLARE23_0405 and compares with the delivered round-2 masks per organ; re-run masks are in rerun_<release>/<case>.nii.gz (delivered label scheme). Environment identical across releases (nnunetv2 2.8.1, torch 2.5.1+cu121); producer scripts/audit/ts_version/ts_reproduce_showcase.py.
finding: Repeated runs of the SAME release differ from each other by tens to hundreds of voxels (2.18.0: 67/637 on GPU 1, 18/813 on GPU 0; the 10-06 record attributes 27/729 to 2.18.0 and 67/637 to 2.17.0, today 2.17.0 gives 27/729). Release 2.17 and 2.18 therefore cannot be told apart from the outputs. Both reproduce the delivered organ masks to within 0.2 % of organ voxels (0.015-0.16 % over all runs); 2.10.0 differs by 0.71-3.27 %.
quotable: TotalSegmentator v2 (2.17/2.18 releases): re-running either reproduces the released organ masks to within 0.2 % of organ voxels (results/audit/ts_version/).
correction: The 10-06 suggested wording 're-running 2.18.0 reproduces the released organ masks to within 0.1 % of voxels' does not hold: one 2.18.0 run differs by 0.16 % on pancreas_125.
